pages.title: Snow in a Cup
pages.text: For ice dragons: improves direct human-form combat breath damage. Blue ice and snow keep it cold.

pages.title: Crafting the Drink
pages.text: Place one powder snow bucket, blue ice, and dragon ice spike in the same crafting-table column, in any vertical order.

pages.title: An Ice Dragon Accessory
pages.text: Only an ice dragon can wear this drink as an accessory. Even in warm lands, a little frost remains on the rim.
